messages:
linda: ACME POC can't get users provisioned. SCIM calls return 403 'invalid_client' after their IdP team rotated credentials. SAML logins fail with 'Assertion AudienceRestriction' error. They're on a Dedicated pool with VPC peering. Need quick triage and pointer to config changes.
mike: can you drop the last 5 lines from scim-proxy and the SAML assertion snippet? also which API key did they paste into the Dedicated console (hosted vs tenant)?
linda: logs: 
```
scim-proxy: 403 invalid_client - token rejected by authz
scim-proxy: upstream url mismatch: expected https://scim.redwood.company/dedicated/ACME but got https://scim.redwood.company/hosted
saml-acs: AudienceRestriction mismatch: expected https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs but assertion had https://app.example.com/sso
```
tina: quick checklist: 1) Dedicated / tenant-scoped keys start with "rudx-tenant-"; hosted keys are shorter. 2) SCIM base path for Dedicated includes the tenant slug — misconfig there will 403 if token is valid for different audience. 3) Some IdPs append trailing slash to ACS url -> fails audience check.
linda: their team pasted a hosted key (rudx-abc123) into the Dedicated SCIM field during the switch. They said the token rotation was in their IdP last night, but we also rotated the hosted key earlier this week for housekeeping.
mike: two simultaneous issues then: wrong key type + ACS/audience mismatch. For SAML Audience fix ask them to update the SP/Audience to the value from our metadata (send metadata). For SCIM fix they need the tenant key or we can mint a temporary scoped token.
infra-bot: recommend temporary mitigation: create a one-time SCIM token scoped to "acme-poc-temp" valid for 4 hours. Command: `./tools/issue_scim_token --tenant acme --ttl 4h`
mina (onboarding): I'll generate that token and DM it securely. Also prepare a how-to: set SCIM connector URL to `https://scim.redwood.company/dedicated/acme` and Authorization header `Bearer <rudx-tenant-...>`
linda: pasted SAML assertion snippet from Okta (redacted):
```
<saml:NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent\">00u9xY</saml:NameID>
<saml:Audience>https://app.example.com/sso</saml:Audience>
```
mike: that Audience is the IdP app default. They need to add our ACS URL as an Audience or create a separate SAML app for Redwood where ACS == https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs and NameID maps to email. If they can't change global policy, ask IdP to create a dedicated app.
tina: SCIM attribute quirk: Okta sometimes sends 'emails[0].value' instead of plain 'email'. Our mapping supports both, but only if connector uses JSON body not legacy form-encoded payload. Confirm connector type.
linda: they are using Okta's SCIM connector (JSON). Error disappeared after we swapped in the tenant token I created. But SAML Audience still failing.
mina: sent IDP metadata and step-by-step in DM. Also attached a small curl test you can run from their network to validate ACS reachability: 
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer rudx-tenant-temp" https://scim.redwood.company/dedicated/acme/Users | jq .
```
mike: once they update the SP Audience, recommend they rotate the app cert and re-run SAML test in Okta. Steps: 1) Add ACS & Audience values from our metadata; 2) Map user.email -> NameID or add attribute 'email' in assertion; 3) Test with SAML tracer.
linda: ACME made the SP app and updated Audience to our ACS url, mapped NameID to email. Re-tested SAML login -> success. SCIM now working with tenant key.
onboarding-bot: SCIM sync job 5490: 78 created, 3 updated, 0 errors.
infra-bot: follow-up: we added a validation step in the Dedicated console UI to warn when a hosted key is pasted into tenant-scoped fields. We'll ship the UI change tomorrow.
linda: great. ACME confirmed POC access and user provisioning. Closing this thread. Thanks all :tada:
